<GlyphSprite sprite={glyphs.sprite} />

Each glyph below is one `<symbol>` of the glyph set that `modelspec-diagram` generates (DESIGN.md § 13.1); a diagram draws every node with one of them. A family fixes the outline and the accent colour, the operator the mark inside it. A gradient op is its forward operator's glyph with the outline dashed and the `∇` badge in the top right, and when it is the gradient with respect to one of several operands, that operand's slot is marked along the bottom. 58 glyphs in all.

**Source** is the name a `.mspec` file calls the operator by; an operation no source may call is internal. **Gradient op** is the operation the gradient rule of a forward operator emits for it (DESIGN.md § 4); an operator without one takes its gradient through other operators, or takes none.
